question: What is the name of the initiative launched by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj for women elected representatives?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sashakt Panchayat-Netri Abhiyan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• “Sashakt Panchayat-Netri Abhiyan” for Capacity Building of Women Elected Representatives of PRIs Launched.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Panchayati Raj** launched the **“Sashakt Panchayat-Netri Abhiyan”** at a **National Workshop** in **New Delhi**, gathering **over 1,200 women Panchayat leaders** from across India.
 
• This initiative is aimed at strengthening **Women Elected Representatives** of **Panchayati Raj Institutions** to enhance their **leadership acumen**, **decision-making capabilities**, and **grassroots governance** participation.
 
• The initiative provides a **strategic roadmap** to boost the active involvement of women in **local governance**.
 
• Specialized **training modules** were launched, including a **Primer on Law Addressing Gender-Based Violence** and harmful practices specifically designed for **Panchayat Elected Representatives**.
 
• The initiative was launched **ahead of International Women’s Day 2025**.
 
• **Issues of Proxy Sarpanchs** were highlighted, and **women were urged to take the lead** in **Panchayati Raj Institutions**.
